shared_elements: standing human figure in a large panel
figure holding an object in a raised hand
border/band of repeated ornamental motif running along the edge of the panel
carved figural scene filling a rectangular/slab field
justification: Both surfaces show upright human figures holding objects within a field edged by a repeated ornamental band, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A depicts a single large winged, elaborately robed figure with a bucket and cone beside a rosette-laden stylised tree, rendered with careful feather and drapery detail; B depicts two registers of blocky, schematic weapon-bearing figures above a mounted rider on a quadruped with a serpentine creature below, with no wings, tree or rosettes and a wholly different, flat, outline-based manner.
